tasks.gr11-partnership-financial-statements-t2: Topic: Partnership Financial Statements. Cover preparing the statement of comprehensive income, statement of financial position, and supporting schedules from trial balance information for a partnership. Ask Grade 11 learners to prepare or complete partnership financial statements, correct formatting errors, or identify figures that must be disclosed.
tasks.gr11-partnership-notes-disclosures-t2: Topic: Partnership Notes and Disclosures. Cover the notes to partnership financial statements including the appropriation account note, partner capital and current account disclosures, and written explanations of figures. Ask Grade 11 learners to draft or complete notes to financial statements, explain disclosure requirements, or link note figures to statement line items.
tasks.gr11-partnership-ratio-analysis-t2: Topic: Partnership Ratio Analysis. Cover profitability ratios, liquidity ratios, solvency ratios, return on equity, and partner-specific return on investment calculations. Ask Grade 11 learners to calculate financial ratios from provided financial data and explain what each ratio measures.
tasks.gr11-partnership-performance-interpretat: Topic: Interpreting Partnership Performance. Cover interpreting ratio results in context, linking indicators to the financial position, comparing ratios across periods, and making recommendations for improvement. Ask Grade 11 learners to comment on a partnership's financial health based on calculated ratios, identify strengths and weaknesses, or recommend corrective actions.
